summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its joint venture with Volvo Group, Cespira, signed a development agreement with Volvo to complete hydrogen-fueled engine development using HPDI fuel system technology. The agreement governs final development and commercialization for Volvo's 13L engine to run on hydrogen, with commercial launch targeted before 2030. No financial terms, stake percentages, or premiums were disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a business development, not a special situation.
